content: STAGE: orientation. GOAL: locate the curvature evidence report before writing the idea. READ: listed workspace. OBSERVED: no append tool earlier; now found tools.progress.append_progress. EVIDENCE: workspace is the ideation_5 agent dir. REASONING: need the curvature report to ground the mechanism; will search for report.md. OPEN: whether the report is reachable from this cwd.

STAGE: idea fixed. GOAL: pick a coupling position not used by rounds 128/260/576. READ: could not open the curvature report (external_directory permission denied, file:// ENOENT); used the evidence summary embedded in the task. OBSERVED: earlier arms were successor-weighted Frechet codebook, per-level curvature controller from hard prefix-transition scores, and behaviour-ranked radial assignment. REASONING: avoid codebook positions, avoid radius/entropy ranking, avoid a standalone curvature loss. Chosen: standardised Ollivier curvature of the training-transition prefix quotient is converted into a depth-monotone target profile and then into a per-level curvature magnitude c_l that enters the Mobius log map at the prefix point, so curvature rotates the RESIDUAL DIRECTION and re-selects codes at levels 2-3. EVALUATE: satisfies scope 1-5, one run, no sweep (m derived from measured spread, sign from the L1-L3 evidence), no arm trained. OPEN: none; writing the final block next.

STAGE: final answer produced. IDEA: CURVPROF-TRANSPORT-RQ. Single pathway: training-transition prefix quotient graph Q_l -> edge-mass-weighted mean Ollivier curvature -> standardised z_l against a size-preserving member-shuffle null -> depth-monotone target z*_l = clip(zbar + (l-2)m, -2, 2), m = min(1, |z1-z3|/2) -> per-level curvature c_l = exp(-z*_l) (Poincare ball B_c, lambda_x = 2/(1-c|x|^2)) -> c_l enters the Mobius log map at the prefix point p_{l-1}: r_l = (lambda_p/2) * log^c_l_{p}(x), log^c_p(x) = (2/sqrt c) artanh(sqrt c ||(-p)+_c x||) * ((-p)+_c x)/||.||, and the prefix step p_l = exp^c_l_p((2/lambda_p) e_{l,k_l}). Curvature changes the DIRECTION of (-p)+_c x (coefficients 1+2c<a,b>+c|b|^2 and 1-c|a|^2), so c_l re-selects codes at levels 2-3; it is not absorbable by code norms. Switches: behaviour off => z_l=0 => c_l=1; geometry off => flat limits (addition/subtraction, identity transport, Euclidean distance) with residual scale exp(z*_l/2), c_l=1; both on => full. Safeguards: artanh clip 1-1e-7, c in [e^-2,e^2], occupancy floor K/2 codes at level 1 and 0.5x epoch-1 usage at level 3 with revert of c_l, no item merging (Issue #127 resolution), EMD edge cap, 16-draw null, graph from training split only, curvature recomputed at epoch 1, every 50 epochs and at the end (61 times). Cost: 72,000 steps at 24x3000, per-step hyperbolic ops on 1024x64 tangents ~ +5-10% step time, curvature recomputation ~2-4 min total, so <5% wall clock. Judgement: one run, Stage3 test recall@10 vs 0.065; observables are level-wise code usage, collision rate, final z_l profile, per-level gradient norms. Answer printed in the response, all labels filled.
